# Regal Residencia - Comprehensive Project Information

## Overview
Regal Residencia by GDPL is a benchmark luxury residential project situated in Sector 114, Mohali, Punjab. Approved by GMADA (Greater Mohali Area Development Authority), Regal Residencia offers high-end 3 BHK, 3+1 BHK, and 4+1 BHK luxury residential units crafted for modern families seeking comfort, elegance, and premium living standards in the Chandigarh Tricity area.

## Location & Connectivity Advantages
- Address: Sector 114, Kharar-Landran Road, Mohali, Punjab 160011
- Proximity:
  - 5 minutes from Airport Road, Mohali
  - 10 minutes from VR Punjab Mall
  - Near top institutions: CGC Landran, Chandigarh University
  - Quick connectivity to Fortis Hospital & Max Hospital Mohali
  - Direct route to International Airport Chandigarh

## Property Specifications
- 3 BHK Luxury Apartments: Modern layout, premium vitrified flooring, high-end bathroom fittings, spacious balconies.
- 3+1 BHK Premium Apartments: 3 Bedrooms + Servant Room / Utility Store, expansive living room, designer kitchen.
- 4+1 BHK Super Luxury Residences: Grand living & dining spaces, wrap-around balconies, dedicated servant room, master bedroom suite.

## World-Class Amenities
- Grand Clubhouse with Indoor Games
- Temperature-Controlled Swimming Pool & Kids Pool
- State-of-the-art Fitness Center & Gym
- Lush Green Eco-Parks & Jogging Track
- 24/7 Multi-Tier Security with CCTV Surveillance
- Power Backup for common areas and residences
- EV Charging Infrastructure & Covered Parking

## Developer Credentials
- Developed by GDPL (Regal Residencia Team)
- Renowned for timely delivery, structural integrity, and architectural excellence in Punjab real estate.
